_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the baseline 'Practitioner' role. Consumed by BaselineRole.java (in-app startup seeder, local/dev) AND scripts/backfill_practitioner_role.py (pre/post-deploy backfill, all environments). Every RESOURCE key must be a com.pranicdoc.cph.rbac.model.Resource constant and every verb a com.pranicdoc.cph.rbac.model.Operation constant that Resource.supports(). Edit here only; both consumers pick the change up.
name: Practitioner
description: Default working role assigned to every healer on onboarding. Covers day-to-day patient, case, session, PDF, scan, protocol, feedback and credit operations plus read-only reference data.
